statement.zh-TW: 借方永遠代表金額增加，貸方永遠代表金額減少。
statement.en: A debit always means an increase in amount, and a credit always means a decrease.

feedbackTrue.zh-TW: 你把資產的規則套到所有科目上了，對資產與費用來說確實如此。但負債、股東權益與收入剛好相反：增加記貸方、減少記借方。
feedbackTrue.en: You have applied the asset rule to every account; for assets and expenses it is indeed so. But liabilities, equity and revenue work the other way: increases are credits and decreases are debits.

feedbackFalse.zh-TW: 答對了。增加記哪一邊要看科目的性質：資產與費用增加記借方；負債、股東權益與收入增加記貸方。借方與貸方本身只是左邊與右邊。
feedbackFalse.en: Correct. Which side records an increase depends on the kind of account: assets and expenses increase on the debit side; liabilities, equity and revenue increase on the credit side. Debit and credit themselves are just left and right.

explanation.zh-TW: 把會計恆等式想成一座天平：左邊的資產用借方增加，右邊的負債與股東權益用貸方增加；費用跟著資產、收入跟著股東權益。
explanation.en: Picture the accounting equation as a balance: assets on the left grow with debits, liabilities and equity on the right grow with credits; expenses follow assets and revenue follows equity.
